# Partiful

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Invitation marketing: cream floating nav, black hero, janky display type, pill CTAs, plus a separate dark Lausanne app shell.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (login is a phone field; no email, no event created). Themes: light, dark.

Partiful (partiful.com) is an invitations product. This package records the public signed-out marketing site and the signed-out app shell: home, About, Explore, and login. Captured 2026-11-19 from a signed-out T3 preview tab at 1169 by 731 CSS pixels, device pixel ratio 2. Light is the Framer marketing pages. Dark is the live `ptf-dark` / `ptf-app` shell on login and Explore. No account was created. No phone number was entered. No event was created.

13 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Lausanne, Partiful Display Medium, Partiful Janky Inter Display Regular, TWK Lausanne Pan 300.

### Fonts (from README.md)

| Family | Where it painted | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Partiful Janky Inter Display Regular | Home h1 and section display, weight 400 | Proprietary. Not committed |
| Partiful Display Medium | About h1, weight 500 | Proprietary. Not committed |
| TWK Lausanne Pan 300, 400, 500, 550, 600 | Marketing body, nav, buttons | Proprietary. Not committed |
| Lausanne | Login and Explore body, headings, fields | Proprietary. The app names it Lausanne, not TWK Lausanne Pan. Not committed |

Tokens name the measured family and fall back to `sans-serif`. The style guide does the same.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The preview browser returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames." There are no screenshots and no crops. Layout claims in this README come from DOM measurements, not from a reviewed PNG. The catalog cover is [icon.png](icon.png), the site icon, because a cover file is required and no page PNG exists.

`--background-color` resolved to `#252464` and `--primary-color` to `#ab76f6` on login and Explore. The painted page fill was `rgb(17, 17, 17)`. Those two token colours are recorded as declared values. They were not the painted page or the painted buttons on the screens I opened.

`--danger-color` (`#fa304b`) and `--warning-color` (`#ffc562`) resolved and were not painted. Marketing declared `#31c431`, `#ffae00`, `#ffcee3`, `#001666`, and `red`. I did not see those paint on the nodes I sampled.

The marketing favicon is 32 px. [icon.png](icon.png) is that file scaled to 128 px, so it is soft.

Programmatic `focus()` on the phone field did not paint an outline.

The home hero phone mock is a public illustration using SF Pro Text. It is not the product UI.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use cream, ink, and a black hero for the marketing site.** The page is `#f7f7f7`, ink is `#111111`, the nav is 80% `#fdfdfb`, and the hero is `#000000`.
- **Set marketing display in Partiful Janky Inter Display Regular at weight 400.** The home h1 was 64px on 64px, uppercase. Do not invent a bold weight for that face.
- **Use TWK Lausanne Pan for marketing UI.** Nav is 500 at 16px. Buttons are 600 at 16px. Body is 300.
- **Keep marketing nav pills at 200px and hero buttons at 4px.** Both were on the same page. The 800px pill belongs to the app shell.
- **Treat the app shell as its own theme.** Login and Explore paint `#111111` with Lausanne, not the Framer marketing tokens.
- **Leave the phone field and create flow alone.** Login asks for a phone number. Create an invite starts an event. This package stops at the public page.
